verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence is a hands-on community report of writing code in Replit's web editor, which shows the builder includes a code editor. However, it predates the Agent workflow and no first-party docs describe opening or editing Agent-generated source files. The visual design-tweaking space is an adjacent feature and is not credited. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of an in-builder code editor for generated code, evidence that code Agent wrote is viewable and editable in the same workspace, and current independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can open and edit the generated source code directly inside the builder

citations.quote: I use Repl.it web interface for programming on the sofa from my Android phone. There's various bugs in the editor but it works well enough
